children: on Monday it appointed Ian Schworer as Chief Investment Officer, effective Dec. 31, 2026, succeeding Sajal Srivastava.
Schworer has been with TriplePoint Capital since 2014 and most recently served as Chief Credit Officer.
TriplePoint Capital also appointed Schworer as CIO, with co-founder Jim Labe becoming sole CEO.
